query:
SELECT a.id, a.checkInTime, a.checkOutTime, a.durationMinutes, a.packageId, p.totalHours as packageTotalHours
FROM attendances a
LEFT JOIN packages p ON a.packageId = p.id
JOIN residents r ON a.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY a.checkInTime;
